title: Lambda number of the reduced power graph of finite groups
summary: The reduced power graph $Γ_{RP}(G)$ of a group $G$ is a simple graph with vertex set $G$, where two distinct vertices $u$ and $v$ are adjacent if and only if $\langle u \rangle \subset \langle v \rangle$ or $\langle v \rangle \subset \langle u \rangle$. An $L(2,1)$-labeling of a graph $Γ$ is a mapping from the vertex set of $Γ$ to the set of non-negative integers such that the labels of adjacent vertices differ by at least $2$ and the labels of vertices at distance two are distinct.
